selector.why: The evidence of HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL, fever, productive cough, and extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates decided it, which are more specific to Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia in this context.

support_spans: HIV infection with a CD4 count <20 cells/µL
fever to 39.6 °C
a 1-day history of productive cough
Chest radiograph showed a new left upper lobe opacification with diffuse reticulonodular interstitial prominence
CT scan of the chest confirmed extensive reticulonodular interstitial infiltrates with focal consolidation in the left upper lobe
